strings.zh: 按每台每小时约 600 次的假设和数学期望计算。老虎机的优势不是最高的，但它最快。
strings.en: Based on the assumption of about 600 pulls per machine per hour and the expected value. Slot machines don't have the highest edge, but they're the fastest.

strings.zh: 研究者把它叫作“伪装成赢的输”。灯光和音效跟真赢一模一样，大脑就把它记成了赢。玩完你会觉得“赢了好多次”，钱包却不这么认为。
strings.en: Researchers call it a “loss disguised as a win” (LDW). The lights and sounds are identical to a real win, so the brain records it as one. After playing you feel you “won so many times”; your wallet disagrees.
strings.note: 【D4 校对后改了中文，英文已核对】术语表：伪装成赢的输 → loss disguised as win (LDW)，保留缩写；中文引号“”在英文里用弯引号；真赢 → real win；保持冷静、不说教、不加形容词。

1 个

数字 1、105 不变；约 → about；规范第 2 条的示例格式是 “1 in 17,721,088”，故斜杠改 in。

strings.en: The first two are 7, the third isn't
strings.note: 数字 7 不变；前两个/第三个指转轴（下一条 Slots.027 明说第三个转轴），此处按中文省略，不补 reels。

strings.zh: 在这台示例机器上，“差一点”出现的次数是中大奖的 19 倍。因为第三个转轴上的 7，个数只有前两个的一半。
strings.en: On this sample machine, near misses come up 19 times as often as the jackpot, because the third reel has only half as many 7s as each of the first two.
strings.note: 【D6 引用核查后改了中文，英文已核对】【D4 校对后改了中文，英文已核对】数字 19、7 不变；差一点 → near miss（术语表）；中大奖 → the jackpot；只有前两个的一半 → only half as likely as on the first two；因为…保留为独立短句，与原文节奏一致。

strings.zh: 真实的老虎机用程序给每个停点设权重，能把这种感觉做得更频繁。“差一点”在数学上和“完全没中”一样，都是输，但它让人想再来一次。
strings.en: Real slot machines use software to weight each stop, so they can make this feeling more frequent. A “near miss” is mathematically the same as “no win at all” — both are losses — but it makes you want to go again.
strings.note: 停点 → stop（src/engine/slots.ts 注释里的“停点”），NEW TERM；给每个停点设权重 → weight each stop；差一点 → near miss、完全没中 → no win at all（对齐 Slots.011 的 No win）；中文引号改弯引号。

strings.zh: 拉斯维加斯大道老虎机，庄家的实际赢率
strings.en: The house's actual win rate on Las Vegas Strip slot machines
strings.note: 【D4 校对后改了中文，英文已核对】拉斯维加斯大道 → the Las Vegas Strip；这里的“赢率”是赌场角度的赢率（行业术语 hold），与上一条 The house takes 呼应；数值 8.0% 在 HTML 里。直译可能被误读成玩家胜率，见汇报存疑。

strings.zh: 赔付表为本项目设计，返还率是精确计算的。“伪装成赢的输”见 Dixon 等（2010），近失的设计见 Harrigan（2008）。实际赢率：2025 年 9 月，来源 CDC Gaming，2025-10-30。
strings.en: The paytable is designed for this project; the RTP is calculated exactly. On losses disguised as wins, see Dixon et al. (2010); on designed near misses, Harrigan (2008). Actual win rate: September 2025, source CDC Gaming, 2025-10-30.
